correctness.rationale: For n>2k every local cubic majority equilibrium iff each vertex has at most one opposite neighbor. The explicit shift-window transfer automata on 4^(2k) states check exactly the two center-column conditions; their cyclic traces therefore count all labelled fixed states at every n>2k. The cyclic SCC and exact characteristic polynomials are reconstructed in check_transfer.py, yielding F3(n)=3+degree-32 and degree-33 root power sums. Main SCCs are primitive and rational Collatz-Wielandt inequalities certify 1.56485<alpha2<1.56486 and 1.5965<alpha3<1.5966; alpha1=phi>1.6. Independent direct binary majority enumeration through n=11 agrees. The all-size claim follows from matrix proof, not finite simulation.

value.rationale: Exact fixed-point populations and equilibrium entropy are natural dynamical invariants for a classical regular graph family, equivalent to all matching cut colorings. A complete spectral census for the previously unenumerated inner stride three reveals genuine nonmonotonic dependence on edge stride: alpha2<alpha3<alpha1, causing exponentially diverging F3/F2 but exponentially vanishing F3/F1, despite identical vertex numbers and degree. This is a structural qualitative contrast, not merely a tabulation of a larger k or routine numerical increment.
